name: How can I prevent future stucco damage after repairs?
description: Prevent damage by maintaining gutters, sealing cracks around openings, managing irrigation, and considering elastomeric paint for protection.

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future stucco damage after repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future stucco damage involves proper maintenance and addressing potential issues proactively. Ensure your gutters and downspouts are clean and direct water away from your foundation. Regularly inspect around windows, doors, and rooflines for cracks or gaps in caulking, and promptly seal them. Address any landscape irrigation that sprays directly onto stucco. A fresh coat of elastomeric paint can also add a layer of protection against moisture and minor cracking over time.
